# Fastidious Gram-negatives and Gram-negative cocci

> *Why do some bacteria need special food, and why do fragile bacteria spread only by close contact?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
The layout will match that of [*Gram-positive cocci*](gram-positive-cocci.qmd). The plan:
:::

| Part of the chapter | Plan |
|---|---|
| The group in one sentence | Gram-negative bacteria that depend on their host for nutrients, or die quickly outside it |
| Sorting key | Growth needs (enriched media); fragility outside the body; capsule |
| Main organisms | *Neisseria meningitidis* (capsule in the blood), *Neisseria gonorrhoeae* (fragility, antigenic variation), *Haemophilus influenzae* (factors from blood) |
| Supporting organisms | *Bordetella pertussis*, *Legionella*, *Moraxella*, the HACEK group |
| Later in the course | Meningitis, gonorrhoea, whooping cough and Legionnaires disease in the organ blocks |
